away.summary: The Los Angeles Kings are coming off a 8-4 loss to the Colorado Avalanche in their season opener. They have several returning players, including forwards Joel Armia, Alex Laferriere, and Trevor Moore, as well as defensemen Brian Dumoulin and Erik Gustafsson. Anton Forsberg is set to make his season debut as the starting goalie, with Darcy Kuemper confirmed to start. Kevin Fiala is out due to leg surgery.

home.summary: The San Jose Sharks are coming off a 1-0 victory over the Florida Panthers in their season opener. They have several returning players, including forwards Mason Marchment, Macklin Celebrini, and Will Smith, as well as defensemen Darnell Nurse and Dmitry Orlov. Yaroslav Askarov is confirmed to start in goal, with Alex Nedeljkovic as his backup. Adam Gaudette is out due to an upper body injury, and Jacob Trouba is a game-time decision due to illness.
